findings.title: No node has enough example.com/accelerator
findings.cause: the pod requests example.com/accelerator, and no node advertises any (1 node checked): the device plugin that provides it is not running; Deployment train has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient example.com/accelerator. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

evidence.what: no node lists example.com/accelerator in its allocatable resources

findings.fix: Install or fix the device plugin that provides example.com/accelerator (for nvidia.com/gpu, the NVIDIA device plugin or GPU Operator) and check its DaemonSet runs on the nodes that have the hardware; or remove the request.
